'''Qimberly Gaitag-Delio''', known by the nickname '''The Devourer''', was a [[Qiraash/Legends|Qiraash]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lawyer/Legends|attorney]] who was the granddaughter of [[Doffen Gaitag]], the founder of the luxury [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]]. At some point prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Delio represented the businessman [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]] in a lawsuit against [[Dominic Raynor]], the incumbent [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the Wheel.<ref name="Viva Space Vegas" />
